title: Occupational Uniqueness and Wage Growth
abstract: arXiv:2610.28133v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Changes in occupational task content may have different economic implications depending on whether the tasks gained or lost are occupation-specific or already widespread across the economy. Existing measures of occupational task change largely abstract from this distinction, treating occupations as self-contained task bundles rather than accounting for how tasks are distributed across occupations. We develop a framework to measure a distinct dimension of occupational change, one that goes beyond task expertise or task content: task structure. Using this new framework that tracks tasks across occupations and over time, we separate changes in task quantity from changes in occupational uniqueness, defined as the distinctiveness of an occupation's task bundle relative to other occupations. translated_title: 职业独特性与工资增长
translated_abstract: 职业任务内容的变化可能产生不同的经济影响，这取决于所获得或失去的任务是该职业特有的，还是已经在整个经济中普遍存在的任务。现有的职业任务变化度量方法在很大程度上忽略了这一区别，将职业视为自成一体的任务集合，而没有考虑任务在各职业之间的分布情况。我们开发了一个框架来衡量职业变化的一个独特维度，这一维度超越了任务专业性或任务内容，即任务结构。利用这一追踪各职业及各时期任务的新框架，我们将任务数量的变化与职业独特性的变化分离开来，职业独特性定义为某一职业的任务集合相对于其他职业的显著程度。我们使用了一个统一的数据集，该数据集包含来自《职业名称词典》和O*NET的196,563条任务描述，时间跨度为1977年至2018年，我们据此测量了任务扩散……
tldr: 本文提出了一个衡量职业任务结构的新框架，将任务数量变化与职业独特性变化相分离，并利用1977-2018年间近20万条职业任务描述数据研究职业独特性与工资增长之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a novel framework for measuring occupational task structure that disentangles changes in task quantity from changes in occupational uniqueness, and uses a harmonized dataset of nearly 200,000 task statements spanning 1977-2018 to study the relationship between occupational uniqueness and wage growth.
